dsh-pixel-studio#dsh-cli-anything-aseprite is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Aseprite-style pixel art studio: the AI draws sprites stroke by stroke with selections, layers, animation frames, gradients, symmetry and reference layers, each step rendered live as ANSI terminal frames.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-2466f651d38ddc0251bc.html
